entries.summary: Talent cards that never bound to a controller no longer crash the compendium or the starting pick (the call is skipped and logged); new R.debug.watch_components for watching a hero's parts live; talent-pool probe reports which pick pool is empty.
highlights: Fixed a crash when opening the compendium or the starting talent pick for a hero whose talent cards did not load
New R.debug.watch_components(pattern, opts): log which of the hero's parts change when a button is pressed
The talent probe now reports per-pool counts and which pool the next pick deals from

entries.summary: Bundles loader v57 with mouse drag and mouse-look support for mods.
highlights: Bundles loader v57 with mouse drag and mouse-look support for mods.

entries.summary: Mods can turn the camera with a mouse drag and run a mouse-look mode; keybinds stay quiet on every menu screen; a mod saving settings no longer undoes a pause-menu change.
highlights: Mods can read a held mouse-button drag (R.input.on_drag) and run a mouse-look mode that holds the cursor at the screen centre (R.input.mouse_look).
R.camera exposes the look offset under its real name - the old height field was a ground offset, not a height.
Mod keybinds no longer fire on the talent choice, the Sandman shop and the other screens that give you the cursor.
A mod saving one of its settings no longer undoes a change you just made on the pause menu's Mods page.

entries.summary: Adds the symbols behind mod keybinds in the Controls menu and bundles the loader that supports them.
highlights: Adds the symbols behind mod keybinds in the Controls menu and bundles the loader that supports them.

entries.summary: Mods can add their own keybinds to the Controls menu; players see and rebind them next to the game's keys.
highlights: Mods can add their own keybinds to the Controls menu; players see and rebind them next to the game's keys.

entries.summary: Gameplay-mod detection now checks SDK access per Lua token and scope, and treats access it cannot follow as gameplay.
highlights: Gameplay-mod detection now checks SDK access per Lua token and scope, and treats access it cannot follow as gameplay.

entries.summary: Public matchmaking is blocked while gameplay-changing mods are applied; private lobbies still work.
highlights: Public matchmaking is blocked while gameplay-changing mods are applied; private lobbies still work.

entries.summary: Skigim Input V.10
highlights: Skigim Input V.10

entries.summary: Paid content stays paid, plus a tidier repo and docs.
highlights: Paid DLC heroes can't be cloned or have their art borrowed, and the save editor no longer changes outfit or achievement locks.
Example mods moved to examples/; ExampleSeedPin now uses the SDK instead of raw addresses.
New contributing guide, security policy and bug report form.

entries.summary: Paid content stays paid: the hero-unlock helper no longer opens the DLC ownership gate, and the skin filter only shows outfit packs the loader itself created.
highlights: Paid content stays paid: the hero-unlock helper no longer opens the DLC ownership gate, and the skin filter only shows outfit packs the loader itself created.

entries.summary: Camera mods: pitch, distance and look height now carry to every hero camera; cameras that appear after the first scan (or that a hero ships its own of) are picked up; the camera search runs in slices so it no longer stalls.
highlights: Camera mods: pitch, distance and look height now carry to every hero camera; cameras that appear after the first scan (or that a hero ships its own of) are picked up; the camera search runs in slices so it no longer stalls.

entries.summary: fmod-sounds config picker: mute any in-game sound from a mod's config (categories, folders, one list per hero); multiselect config fixes
highlights: New fmod-sounds config option source: lists every sound from the installed game, including one list per hero
Multi-choice mod settings are no longer lost when a mod saves another setting

entries.summary: Mute any in-game sound you want, from a mod's config.
highlights: New R.audio SDK: mute everything, a mixer category (music, voices, menus), a sound folder, or single sounds
New fmod-sounds config picker lists every sound from the installed game, including one list per hero
Multi-choice mod settings now reach a mod's Lua and are no longer lost when a mod saves another setting

entries.summary: R.audio: mute any in-game sound — everything, a mixer category (music, voices, menus), a folder, or single events (FMOD export hooks, no game addresses). Multiselect config values now reach mod Lua and survive config rewrites.
highlights: R.audio: mute any in-game sound — everything, a mixer category (music, voices, menus), a folder, or single events (FMOD export hooks, no game addresses). Multiselect config values now reach mod Lua and survive config rewrites.

entries.summary: Item actions: items can reset cooldowns, upgrade talents, duplicate items and spawn consumables; editor support; two content-emit fixes
highlights: Items can now DO things: an effects entry with `action` resets a cooldown, upgrades talents, duplicates an item or spawns consumables, once on pickup or on a trigger
The item editor has a "+ Action" row for them
A typo in a talent or item patch list no longer stops the whole apply for every mod
Packed talent mods no longer fail to emit on the installing player's machine

entries.summary: Hero builder: one-byte flag fields can be set (bleed from a spawned bomb now respects armour plates); Hero tab writes lint-valid bases; Sun Wukong talents open again; greyed Save explains why
highlights: Hero builder: set can now change one-byte flag fields (lets a bomb's bleed respect armour plates)
Editor Hero tab: heroes it creates no longer fail rsmm lint (base was written as Red_Update6)
Editor: Sun Wukong talent mods open again
Editor Hero tab: a greyed-out Save button now says why

entries.summary: Hero builder: spawned objects (bombs, orbs) can now carry their own bleed; ability steps refuse copying parts across data versions; link can point a plain number at a value
highlights: Heroes: bleed applied by a spawned bomb now deals damage (it needs its own damage owner)
Hero ability steps: copying a part from a newer-version entity is refused with a clear error instead of silently breaking the entity
Hero ability steps: link can now make a plain number read another part

entries.summary: Custom heroes get their own life bar (rage, combo, timers); new override and replace_subobject ability steps, add_subobject copies from other entities
highlights: Custom heroes now get their own life bar, so a Scarlet clone shows its rage gauge and combo points
New ability steps: override (replace an inherited part) and replace_subobject; add_subobject can copy from another hero

entries.summary: update-loader now refreshes the pattern DB with a new SDK (fixes 'symbols unavailable' for R.modifier.max_selected); clearer resolve-gate message for a stale local pattern DB
highlights: Custom Mode modifier cap mods work right after a loader update — no manual update-data needed
Clearer message when a source checkout's pattern DB is out of date

entries.summary: Custom Mode: R.modifier.max_selected(n) raises the 5-modifier cap (book page + run start); UiLayouterEntityCpntSettings schema for entity mods (#72)
highlights: Custom Mode: R.modifier.max_selected(n) raises the 5-modifier cap (book page + run start); UiLayouterEntityCpntSettings schema for entity mods (#72)

entries.summary: style(desktop): write the design system down, share the text field and screenshot viewer, size dialogs to the window
highlights: Skigim

entries.summary: Hero builder and anonymous install counting.
highlights: Hero builder: build a hero's abilities from blocks, with much faster apply
The app now sends one anonymous ping a day so we can count real installs — turn it off in Settings → Privacy

entries.summary: Hero builder: make a hero and build its abilities from blocks; much faster apply
highlights: New Hero tab in the editor: pick a hero to build on, name it, then give each button a new ability from blocks: fire any projectile (enemies' too) in fans or side by side, hit areas, heals, waits and repeats
Projectiles can burn, poison, root, curse, explode, ricochet, return (Kintaro's axe) and refresh their lifetime on hit (the Snow Queen's shard)
Scarlet-based heroes can be locked to wolf form, and any button can be removed
Items can grant Stars of Fate on a trigger, e.g. +1 every time night begins
rsmm apply builds custom heroes far faster (minutes down to seconds)

entries.summary: Windows Title bar dragging fix by Skigim
highlights: See changelog

entries.summary: Symbol map corrections for build b9c3642: two mis-mapped flag serializers dropped, 16 more engine functions located (#66)
highlights: Symbol map corrections for build b9c3642: two mis-mapped flag serializers dropped, 16 more engine functions located (#66)

entries.summary: Talent range modifiers, and fixes for integer item stats and inherited rewires
highlights: New talent range modifiers: grow an ability's melee reach, shot range, area radius or rectangle in the editor's Make an ability bigger
An ability's area hits grow with its radius, Snow Queen's skating hitbox included, from their own vanilla size
Integer stats such as Extra MO Choice, Extra skill choice and Rooted are written as whole numbers, so items and talents giving them work
A range talent refuses a range its ability lacks instead of scaling another ability's
Rework talents refuse an ambiguous rewire into an inherited file instead of wiring the wrong node

entries.summary: Item effect fixes: Vitality and Attack power entered in displayed points, correct card units for flat stats, per-level shield scaling
highlights: Vitality and Attack power effects are entered as the number shown in game (10 = +10%), no more x100 bonuses
Armour, Shield and other flat stats show their real number on item cards instead of x100
New per_level = true: item effects can grow with hero level, like Fairy Dust's shield
Fractional Free Reroll amounts are rejected instead of silently rounding to 0

entries.summary: Pams fixes
highlights: Pams fixes

entries.summary: In-game Mods menu support: mods switched on or off in Settings > Mods are carried into your library on the next launch, and the pause menu gets a Mods button. Integer item stats (free rerolls, charges) now show their real number on the card instead of +0.
highlights: In-game Mods menu support: mods switched on or off in Settings > Mods are carried into your library on the next launch, and the pause menu gets a Mods button. Integer item stats (free rerolls, charges) now show their real number on the card instead of +0.

entries.summary: In-game Mods menu: a Mods tab in the game's own Settings page (switch mods on or off for the next launch, change mod settings while you play) and a Mods button in the pause menu. Replaces the old drawn overlay.
highlights: In-game Mods menu: a Mods tab in the game's own Settings page (switch mods on or off for the next launch, change mod settings while you play) and a Mods button in the pause menu. Replaces the old drawn overlay.

entries.summary: Custom item effects now stack with duplicate copies: holding a second copy raises the stat and the card number (always-on and timed effects; super effects unchanged).
highlights: Custom item effects now stack with duplicate copies: holding a second copy raises the stat and the card number (always-on and timed effects; super effects unchanged).

entries.summary: In-game mod menu: an ImGui panel drawn on the game's DX12 swapchain, painted onto the book. Adds R.debug.components.
highlights: In-game mod menu: an ImGui panel drawn on the game's DX12 swapchain, painted onto the book. Adds R.debug.components.

entries.summary: Supper Effect on Items and Always on Night/Day
highlights: Supper Effect on Items and Always on Night/Day

entries.summary: Talents can give a TRAIT charge
highlights: Talents can give +1 TRAIT charge, the same way Merlin's quest and Snow Queen's Trait Charge do (TRAIT charges were refused before)

entries.summary: Talents built from scratch reliably, game-event triggers, and a simpler talent editor
highlights: Talent changes no longer copy parts from other heroes: every part is written, so talent mods are more reliable across game updates
Talent bonuses can start from game events: taking damage, your ultimate, day or night, picking a talent or item, dream shards, Sandman purchases, rerolls
Every option the talent editor offers now builds, for every hero (several failed before, e.g. on Kintaro and Snow Queen)
The talent editor has one place to change what a talent does: the builder, which can add to a talent or replace it
Charges that the game never grants (TRAIT charges) are refused, and charges show as whole numbers

entries.summary: Items from scratch, safer item bans, and a warning for item stats the game never reads
highlights: Item bans no longer wipe the save progress of banned items: apply and restore put back what the game dropped
You can ban every item: empty vendor pools get a harmless Sold Out item instead of crashing the game
Make magical objects from scratch: list always-on and after-a-trigger bonuses, no base item needed
The item editor gets Start from scratch, an effects list and ids of any length
Lint warns when an item's effect changes a stat the game never reads

entries.summary: Editor: card text no longer garbled in a local clone; clearer tabs, custom item flow and talent builder
highlights: Item and talent card text is readable again in the local editor (a font table and page from different game builds were paired)
Tabs say what each editor does, and a short tour opens on first launch
"+ New custom item" starts a new item from a copy of a shipped one
Talent builder blocks are named, say what they do in plain words, and show each rarity's number as the card shows it

entries.summary: Discord Url Update
highlights: Discord Link Update

entries.summary: Item mods: timed effects on any item, build checks, and a real card preview in the editor.
highlights: New item field effect = { stat, amount, seconds, on }: a timed bonus on a trigger (taking damage, dash, special, defense, power, talent picked, item picked up, dream shards, night, and more), with the item icon counting it down
Copied items get their own identity by default, so picking up another item no longer takes one away
rsmm lint and the build warn about item traps: bonuses that stack forever, hidden level scaling, a card that reads +0%
The item editor gets a Timed effect section and a card preview that shows the numbers the game will print

entries.summary: Item mods: timed bonuses and correct cards. Copied items show their own description, can drop the super effect, show fractions as percentages, and can copy parts from other items.
highlights: Items can copy parts from another item with clone steps (from = an entity path), e.g. a timed '+X for N seconds' bonus
New percent step shows a card number as a percentage (a 0.3 crit bonus read '+0%')
super_effect = false removes a copy's super effect and its card text
A copy now shows its own description even when its base's text key does not contain the base id
The item editor gets an own-identity checkbox for copies, so a copy is not granted as its base

entries.summary: Item mods can fix behaviour, not just numbers: new [[content.steps]] graph edits on a copied item. The editor now opens and saves items that use them.
highlights: Item mods take [[content.steps]] (set / link / add_link / remove_link) to rewire a copied item, e.g. turn a permanent on-hit bonus into a timed one
The item editor opens and saves items with steps instead of refusing them
Fixed link labels written into entities whose shipped references are stale

entries.summary: Item copies can change rarity, the book fits added items, and the map editor edits scenery.
highlights: A copied item now really takes the rarity you pick in the editor or manifest; before, it kept its base item's tier in game.
The book's Objects tab widens each tier's grid when mods add items, so new items no longer spill over the next row.
Map editor: move, remove and add a chapter's own scenery objects, plus a 3D tile mode.
The editors answer faster: newest request first, and game data is kept between visits.

entries.summary: Chapter editor, CLI updates without an app release, and a restore fix that protects game files
highlights: The map editor is now a chapter editor: add, move and remove spots, pin tiles, and paint terrain shape, surface and tint
The CLI now updates on its own between app releases; Settings > Updates and the version footer show which CLI build is running
Fixed: after a game update, restoring could delete the game's hero files and leave only Random on hero select
Fixed: the Update 5 backport's hero table was undone on the next apply

entries.summary: Restore no longer deletes game files when the asset map is from an older game build; the values backport now stays applied
highlights: Fixed: after a game update, restoring could delete the game's hero files and leave only Random on hero select. The asset map is now rebuilt before apply and restore.
Fixed: the Update 5 backport's hero table was undone on the next apply, so the old values never reached the game.

entries.summary: The app opens links, feels faster, and can get CLI fixes without a new release.
highlights: Links in the app (Discord, Ko-fi, GitHub, docs) open in your browser again.
Screens load much faster: the CLI stays warm between calls instead of restarting each time.
Linux AppImage: built on a newer base, so it no longer runs sluggishly. It needs glibc 2.39 (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, Fedora 40 or newer); older systems should use the .deb.
CLI fixes can now arrive between app releases; Settings, About shows which CLI build is running.
Release notes for loader updates show a proper heading.

entries.summary: First CLI channel build: Python fixes now reach the app without an app release; read-only commands answer from one warm process
highlights: First CLI channel build: Python fixes now reach the app without an app release; read-only commands answer from one warm process

entries.summary: The damage meter now names your teammates exactly, by the hero each of them plays.
highlights: Damage meter: teammates are matched to their row by the hero they picked in the lobby, so their names no longer carry a '?'.
Damage meter: crits and blocked damage are counted, and damage taken matches the game's own total.
Damage meter: the per-ability split works again after Update 6.
Overlays hide a column no row has data for, so mods can add optional columns behind a setting.

entries.summary: Mods can offer settings for their game-data edits: sliders and switches in a mod's config now drive its numbers.
highlights: Mod authors: entity edits can take a value from the mod's config (`config`, `times`) and be switched on or off (`when`).
Mod authors: [[patch]] stat values can come from config too, e.g. a camp size slider.
Changing such a setting rebuilds the mod's files on the next launch.

entries.summary: Mod pages in your language, Update 6 fixes for hero picks, and a new challenge content kind.
highlights: Browse and mod pages show a mod's own translation (name, summary, description) when the app runs in that language.
Hero ids fixed for Update 6; picking a hero someone else took is handled more safely.
New 'challenge' content kind (experimental) for editing the run challenges.
Lint warns when a mod edits a hero part that Update 6 replaced, so the edit would do nothing.
A small, dismissible Ko-fi note on the Library after a few modded launches.

entries.summary: Update 6 symbols, taken-hero pick, va-gate hash
highlights: Update 6 symbols, taken-hero pick, va-gate hash
